title: Beginner Fat Loss Program - 4 Weeks

exercises.name: Warmup & Mobility
exercises.notes: World's greatest stretch 5x each, hip flexor stretch 30s each, arm circles 20x, cat-cow 10x.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.notes: Maintain a proud chest and keep your core tight throughout the movement. Focus on depth.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Lower the bar with control to your chest, keeping elbows at a 45-degree angle. Drive through your feet.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Pull the bar down towards your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Control the eccentric.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Maintain a slight bend in the knees, hinge at the hips, feeling the stretch in hamstrings. Keep your back straight.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.notes: Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels, engage your core. Avoid sagging hips or arching back.

exercises.name: Jump Squats
exercises.notes: Metabolic Finisher Circuit (10-15 min total): Perform 15-20 reps of Jump Squats, immediately followed by Push-ups, then Mountain Climbers. Rest 30s after Mountain Climbers. Repeat for 3 total rounds.

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.notes: Part of Metabolic Finisher Circuit. Keep your body in a straight line. Drop to knees if needed to maintain form.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.notes: Part of Metabolic Finisher Circuit. Drive knees towards chest in a rapid motion. Keep core engaged.

exercises.name: Warmup & Mobility
exercises.notes: Light cardio 5 min (e.g., dynamic walk/jog), leg swings 10x each, arm circles 20x.

exercises.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
exercises.notes: Focus on maintaining a steady, comfortable pace. Incline walking maximizes calorie burn without high impact. Choose a challenging but sustainable incline.

exercises.name: Warmup & Mobility
exercises.notes: World's greatest stretch 5x each, hip flexor stretch 30s each, arm circles 20x, cat-cow 10x.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Hold the dumbbell close to your chest. Keep your elbows inside your knees at the bottom.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Lower the dumbbells with control. Maintain a slight arch in your lower back. Focus on chest contraction.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.notes: Keep your back straight, pull the handle towards your lower abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: Hyperextension (Back Extension)
exercises.notes: Focus on hinging at the hips, squeezing your glutes at the top. Avoid overextending your lower back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
exercises.notes: Press the dumbbells straight overhead, avoiding excessive arching in your lower back. Control the descent.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swings
exercises.notes: Metabolic Finisher Circuit (10-15 min total): Perform 15-20 reps of Kettlebell Swings, immediately followed by Burpees, then Bicycle Crunches. Rest 30s after Bicycle Crunches. Repeat for 3 total rounds.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.notes: Part of Metabolic Finisher Circuit. Focus on a smooth, explosive movement. Modify with step-back if needed.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunches
exercises.notes: Part of Metabolic Finisher Circuit. Lie on your back, bring opposite elbow to opposite knee. Keep core engaged.

exercises.name: Warmup & Mobility
exercises.notes: Light cardio 5 min (e.g., dynamic walk/jog), leg swings 10x each, arm circles 20x.

exercises.name: Elliptical Trainer
exercises.notes: Vary resistance and stride length to engage different muscle groups. Maintain a consistent effort level.

exercises.name: Warmup & Mobility
exercises.notes: World's greatest stretch 5x each, hip flexor stretch 30s each, arm circles 20x, cat-cow 10x.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.notes: Keep your back pressed against the pad. Lower the weight until your knees are at 90 degrees, then drive through your heels.

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.notes: Perform as many reps as possible with good form. Keep your body straight from head to heels.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-up Machine
exercises.notes: Choose an assistance level that allows you to complete reps with good form. Pull your chest towards the bar.

exercises.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
exercises.notes: Place the barbell across your hips. Drive through your heels, squeezing your glutes at the top. Maintain a neutral spine.

exercises.name: Renegade Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.notes: Start in a plank position with hands on dumbbells. Row one dumbbell to your side, keeping your core stable and hips still.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
exercises.notes: Metabolic Finisher Circuit (10-15 min total): Perform 15-20 reps per leg of Walking Lunges, immediately followed by Battle Ropes (30s), then Russian Twists. Rest 30s after Russian Twists. Repeat for 3 total rounds.

exercises.name: Battle Ropes
exercises.notes: Part of Metabolic Finisher Circuit. Create waves with your arms, engaging your entire body. Maintain a slight squat.

exercises.name: Russian Twists
exercises.notes: Part of Metabolic Finisher Circuit. Twist your torso from side to side, keeping your core tight. Use a light weight if desired.
